objective: Test whether one FP16 output-row anchor plus a per-tensor 4-bit log-ratio codebook repairs the rejected Qwen3.8-27B global 4-bit scale representation while remaining close to the base-3 storage limit

scope.claim_boundary: static scale reconstruction on the authenticated mapped 402-tensor Qwen3.8-27B artifact only

parent_negative.diagnosis: one global linear-scale 16-entry codebook per tensor spends entries on cross-row magnitude variation

candidate.row_anchor: geometric mean of nonzero group scales in each output row, frozen to FP16
candidate.ratio_codebook: one 16-entry FP16 multiplicative codebook per tensor with entry zero fixed to exact zero
candidate.fit: deterministic Lloyd iterations in log-ratio space
candidate.final_assignment: minimum absolute scale error against frozen FP16-anchor times FP16-ratio products
candidate.decoder_accumulation: FP32 multiplication of the two stored FP16 factors

storage_gate.future_complete_bundle_rule: if static reconstruction passes, inventory all remaining 264 rank-2+ tensors and require a separately measured complete-bundle projection no greater than 1.64 bpw before export

promotion_rules: all 402 tensor sources and outputs must be authenticated and restartable
all three frozen reconstruction limits and the storage limit must pass
a static pass authorizes only the remaining-tensor fit and complete storage accounting
CUTE, MATH, MMLU-type, WikiText, and runtime evaluation remain mandatory after any export
infrastructure-invalid work is neither a zero nor a completed score
this gate cannot establish a model-quality or breakthrough claim
